description.blurb: The European Space Agency's Huygens Probe was a unique, advanced spacecraft and a crucial part of the overall Cassini mission to explore Saturn.
description.more: The probe was about 9 feet wide (2.7 meters) and weighed roughly 700 pounds (318 kilograms). It was built like a shellfish: a hard shell protected its delicate interior from high temperatures during the a two hour and 27 minute descent through the atmosphere of Saturn's giant moon Titan. Huygens landed on Titan on January 14, 2005.
